ChatGPT is powerful, but most people don’t get great results. I’ve seen these same mistakes repeated by students, entrepreneurs, and even executives. After writing 40+ AI books and helping businesses adopt AI, here are the top 5 mistakes — and what to do instead.
1️⃣ Being Too Vague Vague: “Write a business plan for me.” Precise: “You are a startup consultant. Write a business plan for a subscription-based fitness app targeting working professionals.
